⸻

🌍 AI Prompt for Smart Travel Planning Website (India-wide)

Prompt:
Act as a senior full-stack developer, travel-tech expert, and product designer.
I want to build a smart travel planning web application for ALL of INDIA (every city, town, destination).

🔹 Core Idea:

Create a website where a user enters:
	•	Starting location
	•	Destination

And the system calculates:
	1.	Cheapest travel options (bus, train, flight, cab)
	2.	Comparison of cost + time
	3.	Best budget-friendly route

⸻

🔹 Destination Exploration Feature:
	•	Show tourist places within 100 km radius of the destination
	•	Categorize places:
	•	Historical
	•	Nature
	•	Religious
	•	Adventure
	•	Distance from destination
	•	Estimated local travel cost

⸻

🔹 Stay & Budget Planning:
	•	Suggest cheap & best stays:
	•	Hotels
	•	Hostels
	•	Budget lodges
	•	Show:
	•	Per-night cost
	•	Area/location
	•	Budget vs comfort comparison

⸻

🔹 Final Expense Calculator:

Calculate total estimated trip cost, including:
	•	Travel cost (source → destination)
	•	Local travel (within 100 km)
	•	Stay cost (per day × number of days)
	•	Approx food expense (budget option)

Display:
	•	Minimum possible budget
	•	Recommended budget

⸻

🔹 Coverage:
	•	Must work for entire India
	•	Every state, city, town, tourist place

⸻

🔹 Technical Requirements:
	•	Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript (responsive UI)
	•	Backend: Node.js + Express
	•	FREE Database: MongoDB Atlas (free tier)
	•	Use external APIs (maps, distance, places, transport pricing – mock data if real APIs are paid)

⸻

🔹 Output Required:
	•	Complete project folder structure
	•	Full frontend & backend source code
	•	Database schema
	•	API logic explanation
	•	Step-by-step setup guide
	•	Free deployment guide (Vercel / Render)
	•	Beginner-friendly explanation with comments

Build it as a real-world, scalable product, suitable for college final year project and future startup potential.

⸻

🔥 Optional Add-On (Highly Recommended)

You can add this line at the end of the prompt:

Also include future scope, AI recommendation system, and monetization ideas.

⸻

Here is the complete code for the "Smart Travel India" web application.

This application is built as a highly sophisticated Single Page Application (SPA) using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. It leverages the **Google Gemini API** to act as the "backend brain," eliminating the immediate need for a complex Node.js server for data scraping. The AI intelligently generates realistic travel routes, pricing estimates, accommodation options, and sightseeing itineraries based on its vast training data of Indian travel logistics.

### Architecture Overview
1.  **Frontend**: React 18 + TypeScript.
2.  **Styling**: Tailwind CSS for a mobile-first, professional design.
3.  **Intelligence Engine (Backend Logic)**: Google Gemini API (`gemini-3-flash-preview`). It calculates routes, estimates costs, and suggests itineraries in real-time.
4.  **State Management**: React Hooks (`useState`, `useContext` pattern via props).

### Prerequisites
You must have a Google Cloud Project with the Gemini API enabled and an API Key stored in your environment (e.g., `.env` locally or Vercel environment variables) as `REACT_APP_GEMINI_API_KEY` or simply `API_KEY` depending on your build tool. This code assumes `process.env.API_KEY` is available.

    ```env
    API_KEY=AIzaSy...
    ```
